A '''Duros''' was a council member of [[Unidentified city (Cad Bane)|city]] on [[Duro]] during the [[Republic Era]]. When [[Niro]] visited the town hall, the [[Duros]] suggested sending [[droid]]s to deal with [[Cad Bane]], whose return to their home was imminent.<ref name="One Good Deed" />
